comments.author: Landonk89
comments.body_html: In my testing I didn’t notice any performance impact running on RTX 3080 10gb. I’ve found SPT to perform very well on Linux especially when paired with a FIKA headless client running on a dedicated PC. I’m seeing up to 120 FPS on maps other than Factory (maybe not Streets lol) even on max settings, if you have an extra PC I highly recommend it.
